status: Ideation track 2 draft. Nothing here is decided.
stat_scale: Rulebook 1.2.5 working scale, about double Battlegrounds. Mice sit under the usual body on purpose, most of all in Health.
shared_rules: ../SHARED-RULES.md is the glossary and the rulings between tribes. Keyword spellings and reminder text here are copied from it; where the two differ, it wins.

rules.types: Voles, shrews and dormice in this list are all Mice for 'your Mice'. The second word on the type line is flavour; no card reads it. No Mouse is a Knight or a Squire (those are Badger type words).

pile_on.what: When a friendly unit attacks, each of its neighbours that has Pile on hits the same enemy before the attack lands.
pile_on.neighbour: Rulebook 8.2.3: the units next to it in its row, in front of it and behind it. Up to four.
pile_on.when: Rulebook 9.6.1 step 2. Order: the attacker's own 'whenever this attacks' effects (Fury, a Scout's Cousin), then 'whenever a neighbour attacks' effects (the Captain's Cousin), then the pile-on. A unit summoned earlier in that step can pile on.
pile_on.together: All the pile-on hits land at the same moment. Every unit that piled on counts as having piled on, even when another's hit would have been enough.
pile_on.hit: Each pile-on is a Hit: it deals the unit's Attack to the target, and the unit takes nothing back.
pile_on.target_dies: If the target is dead after the pile-on, the attack ends there (9.6.1, last line): the attacker deals no damage and takes none, and nothing carries on by Overrun or Cleave. Its attack is used up. Death resolution (9.7) and the attacker's 'after this attacks' effects still happen. The attacker did not kill the target, so 'after this kills' effects on it don't trigger (no Medal for a Flying Ace, no extra attack for The Oakfeller).
pile_on.not_an_attack: Piling on isn't attacking. It doesn't trigger 'whenever this attacks' or 'whenever this is attacked' (Fury, Thorns, Gate Warden), doesn't move the attack pointer, and Cleave and Overrun don't apply to it. A unit with 0 Attack doesn't pile on.
pile_on.any_attack: It answers any attack by a neighbour of any tribe: its turn, a second attack, an 'attacks immediately', a Sortie (the pile-on then lands on the back-row target).
pile_on.attacker_gone: If the attacker dies or leaves in step 1 (Thorns), nobody piles on: there is no attack left to join.
pile_on.others: Thorns and other 'whenever this is attacked' effects act on the attacker only, in step 1. A mouse that Thorns kill never gets its pile-on, so Thorns are a strong answer to mice.

hit.what: Hit X: deal this unit's Attack to X as damage. This unit takes none back.
hit.rules: Not an attack: no 'whenever this attacks' or 'is attacked' effect triggers, on either side, and Guard and rows don't limit it. The unit's Attack as it stands is used: slot buffs, lent Attack and auras count. 'The enemy with the least Health' looks at both rows (9.5.6) and current Health; ties are random. Stiff Upper Lip can save its target like any damage.

rules.cousins: A Cousin is summoned into the empty slot nearest its source (8.4.2). With no empty slot it is lost (8.4.5); unlike a Locust Hopper it never waits.

keywords.Pile on: Whenever a neighbour attacks, this hits the target first.
keywords.Hit: Deal this unit's Attack as damage. It takes none back.
keywords.Slot buff: Stays on the slot. Any unit standing there has it.

tokens.name: Cousin
reminders: Pile on: Whenever a neighbour attacks, this hits the target first.
tokens.implementer: Mouse token. Only ever summoned in a fight, so it lasts that fight and never reaches the recruit board. It has its slot's buff and counts as a Mouse. A Cousin with no empty slot to land in is lost (8.4.5); unlike a Locust Hopper it doesn't wait. A golden King Speck summons 4/4 Cousins.

units.name: Needle Page
reminders: Pile on: Whenever a neighbour attacks, this hits the target first.
units.implementer: Pile on as in rules.pile_on. Works next to, behind or in front of any attacker, Mouse or not.

units.name: Hedgerow Scout
units.text: Whenever this attacks, summon a Cousin.
reminders: Cousin: A 2/2 Mouse with Pile on.
units.implementer: A 'whenever this attacks' effect (9.6.1 step 2): the Cousin is placed before any Pile on, in the empty slot nearest the Scout (8.4.2). If that slot neighbours the Scout, the Cousin piles on in this same attack. No empty slot: no Cousin (8.4.5).

units.name: Harvest Piper
units.text: Pile on. When played: Give your other Mice +2 Attack.
reminders: Pile on: Whenever a neighbour attacks, this hits the target first.
units.implementer: When played from hand (7.2.3): every other Mouse on your board gains +2 Attack permanently, on the unit. One-off; moving it does nothing.

units.name: Whetstone Vole
units.text: At the end of your turn, give this slot +3 Attack.
reminders: Slot buff: Stays on the slot. Any unit standing there has it.
units.splash_for: Badgers: a lone Knight's slot gains +3 Attack a turn and keeps it when the Knight is replaced; on an Armsbearer's slot it is lent to both units in front. Pigeons: more Attack on a drilled post, and their Lieutenant deals each slot's Attack buff at the start of the fight.
units.implementer: A slot buff (SHARED-RULES), Attack only, on the slot the Vole stands in when the turn ends (3.4.1). Permanent. The player moves the Vole to lay Attack on a different slot. A Pigeon Regimental Sergeant Major on the board doubles it as it is given.

units.name: Shrew Cutpurse
units.text: Pile on. The first time this piles on each fight, gain 1 gold.
reminders: Pile on: Whenever a neighbour attacks, this hits the target first.
units.implementer: Its first pile-on in a fight earns 1 gold, added at the start of your next turn whether or not it survives. Any neighbour's attack will do, so it earns on any board. Each Cutpurse pays. If it returns in the same fight it doesn't earn again.

units.name: Thimble Captain
units.text: Whenever a neighbour attacks, summon a Cousin.
reminders: Cousin: A 2/2 Mouse with Pile on.
units.splash_for: Pigeons' 'hold the post': when no Reserve unit is left to step in, a Cousin lands in the buffed slot the next time a unit around the Captain attacks. Locusts' devastation: Cousins that die pay the Gleaner and The Eighth Plague like any friendly death.
units.implementer: Triggers in 9.6.1 step 2, after the attacker's own 'whenever this attacks' effects and before any Pile on. Not on its own attacks. The Cousin goes to the empty slot nearest the Captain (8.4.2); if that slot neighbours the attacker it piles on in this same attack. No empty slot: no Cousin.

units.name: Needle Pikeman
units.text: Pile on. Can't attack. After this piles on, it gains +3 Attack permanently (5 a fight).
reminders: Pile on: Whenever a neighbour attacks, this hits the target first.
units.splash_for: Behind any tribe's best attacker: a Badger Knight, a Pigeon Flying Ace. It hits what they attack, first, and grows each time. It also answers attacks made out of turn (Herald of the Charge, Hedge Lancer, The Oakfeller). Two costs on those boards: it is a counted unit, not a Squire, so it lowers a Badger's outnumbered count by 1; and a kill its hit makes is not the attacker's (no Medal for the Ace, no extra attack for The Oakfeller).
units.implementer: Can't attack: it is skipped in the attack order, like a unit with 0 Attack (9.4.6), and an effect that tells it to attack (Herald of the Charge, Kettle-drummer) does nothing. It still deals its Attack back when attacked. After each pile-on it was part of, it gains +3 (the gain doesn't count for the hit that earned it), on the unit in the fight and on the recruit board (12.1.1), kept if it dies later in that fight. At most 5 times a fight; a return in the same fight doesn't reset the count.

units.name: Toothpick Ballista
units.text: Start of fight: Hit the enemy with the least Health.
reminders: Hit: Deal this unit's Attack as damage. It takes none back.
units.golden: Hits twice, choosing again for the second.
units.implementer: Start of fight, main pass (SHARED-RULES, 'Start of fight'). Looks at every enemy in both rows (9.5.6), current Health, ties at random. It attacks as normal afterwards. Slot Attack counts. A Hit is not an attack: no Fury, Thorns or Gate Warden trigger.

units.name: Shrew Harrier
units.implementer: Two attacks back to back on its turn, a new target each time (9.4.11). Each one calls its neighbours' Pile on and the Captain's Cousin. If the first target dies to the pile-on, the Harrier is unharmed and attacks again. 'Attacks twice' from several sources is still twice.

units.name: Spoon Catapult
units.text: Instead of attacking, Hit the enemy with the least Health.
reminders: Hit: Deal this unit's Attack as damage. It takes none back.
units.implementer: When its turn in the attack order comes it doesn't attack: it Hits the lowest-Health enemy in either row. That uses its turn (pointer and flag as for an attack, 9.4.5) and counts toward the attack limit (9.10.1). It is not an attack: no Pile on, no Cousin from the Captain, no Fury or Thorns on the target. Only its own turn is replaced: told to attack out of turn (Herald of the Charge), it makes an ordinary attack. With 'attacks twice' it Hits twice.

units.name: Grindstone Miller
units.text: At the end of your turn, give this slot and its neighbours +2 Attack.
reminders: Slot buff: Stays on the slot. Any unit standing there has it.
units.splash_for: Pigeons' parade ground and Lieutenant; any tribe that keeps its best units in the middle of the board.
units.implementer: Permanent slot buffs, Attack only, on its own slot and the slots neighbouring it (8.2.3), empty or not: five slots from F2, F3 or B2, four from B1 or B3, three from F1 or F4. A Pigeon Regimental Sergeant Major on the board doubles each as it is given.

units.name: Dormouse Cook
units.text: At the end of your turn, if your board is full of Mice, give them +3 Attack.
units.implementer: End of turn (3.4.1): if all seven slots hold Mice, the Cook included, each of them gains +3 Attack permanently, on the unit. One empty slot or one unit of another tribe and nothing happens.

units.name: Fencing Master
units.text: Pile on. The first time each of your Mice piles on in a fight, it gains +3 Attack permanently.
reminders: Pile on: Whenever a neighbour attacks, this hits the target first.
units.implementer: While the Master is on the board: after a friendly Mouse piles on for the first time in this fight (the Master included), that Mouse gains +3 Attack, on the unit in the fight and on the recruit board. Once a fight for each Mouse (a return doesn't reset it), so at most +21 a fight across a board. A second Fencing Master gives its own +3. A Cousin keeps it for the fight only.

units.name: Parish Standard-bearer
units.text: Your Mice have +2 Attack for each Mouse you have.
units.implementer: An aura (12.2.1) while it is on the board. Counts every Mouse on your board, itself and Cousins included, and is recounted whenever one arrives or dies: seven Mice have +14 each, three have +6 each. Two Standard-bearers add up. Aura Attack is borrowed: Eat, Sword-heir and Old Brock don't take it.

units.name: Master of Engines
units.text: Start of fight: Your back-row units each Hit the enemy with the least Health.
reminders: Hit: Deal this unit's Attack as damage. It takes none back.
units.splash_for: Any back row with Attack on it: a Badger Armsbearer, Pigeons standing on drilled back slots, Briars that Grow (stand the Master later in reading order than the Briar, so its Grow has resolved).
units.implementer: Start of fight, main pass, at the Master's place in reading order: B1, then B2, then B3. Each friendly unit there, of any tribe, Hits the lowest-Health enemy with its own Attack as it stands, slot buffs included, choosing again each time. A Needle Pikeman there Hits too (a Hit is not an attack). The Master joins in if it stands in the back row. Start of fight effects later in reading order have not resolved yet.

units.name: Edgewright
units.text: Start of fight: Your slots give double Attack this fight.
reminders: Slot buff: Stays on the slot. Any unit standing there has it.
units.splash_for: Pigeons: every drilled slot hits twice as hard, and the Lieutenant deals double. It stacks with their Regimental Sergeant Major.
units.implementer: Start of fight, set-up pass (SHARED-RULES, 'Start of fight'), so it is on before any effect that reads a slot. For this fight every slot on your board gives double its Attack buff: the stored buff is unchanged and is read at twice its value, by the unit in the slot and by anything that reads a slot's Attack buff (the Pigeons' Lieutenant). It keeps working if the Edgewright dies. Health is not doubled. It stacks with the Regimental Sergeant Major, who doubles buffs when they are given. Two Edgewrights don't stack: the bigger applies (a golden one's triple). The Colour Ensign copies the stored buff, and its slot is then read double like any other.

units.name: King Speck
units.text: Whenever this attacks, fill your empty slots with Cousins.
reminders: Cousin: A 2/2 Mouse with Pile on.
units.implementer: A 'whenever this attacks' effect: a Cousin goes into every empty slot on your board, placed one at a time outward from the King (8.4.2), before any Pile on.

units.name: Dame Bodkin
units.text: Pile on. Pile-on hits deal double damage.
reminders: Pile on: Whenever a neighbour attacks, this hits the target first.
units.implementer: While she is on the board, every pile-on hit by your units, any tribe, deals twice the unit's Attack. Other Hits (the engines) are not doubled. Her type line no longer says Knight: that word is the Badgers'.

units.name: Kettle-drummer
units.splash_for: Pigeons that fly Sorties from the back row; any tribe whose back row is more than supports. It does nothing for a Locust War-drummer, which drums only from the front row.
units.implementer: An aura on your units in B1 to B3, of any tribe, itself included: two attacks back to back on their turn (9.4.11). A Spoon Catapult there Hits twice a turn. A unit that can't attack still can't. 'Attacks twice' from several sources is still twice (a Harrier, a Decorated Pigeon under a Brigadier). Start of fight effects and 'attacks immediately' are not doubled.
